lucid-flyway.description: Added an EXTENSIONS table for document-specific app extensions. Each extension belongs to a document and records the user who installed it.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^EXTENSIONS { C^ uuid id PK C^ uuid document_id FK C^ uuid installed_by_user_id FK C^ string extension_key C^ string display_name C^ boolean enabled C^ datetime installed_at C^} C^DOCUMENTS ||--o{ EXTENSIONS : has C^USERS ||--o{ EXTENSIONS : installs
